meta.title: Freehire Personal - Phase 2 target company research seed
meta.purpose: Curated company/organization seed for Phase 2 source discovery. Prioritizes Italy, then Europe, then selected international employers relevant to Simone's Energy & Nuclear Engineering profile.
selection_principles: Include direct nuclear, energy, EPC, thermal/thermo-fluid, process, plant, aerospace, propulsion, industrial and R&D employers.
Include a deliberate mix of large groups, mid-sized engineering firms and specialist SMEs/supply-chain companies.
Prefer breadth at this stage: source discovery and later job-level ranking decide what is useful.
Organizations are seeds, not trusted source records. Codex must verify the official website, careers page, ATS/provider and board before onboarding.
Do not filter careers by geography during ingestion; collect the official board and filter later.
Subsidiaries are included only when they are useful recruiting/industrial entities in their own right.
Research/public organizations are included when they directly hire engineers in the target domains.
meta.scale_hint_note: scale_hint is a rough research heuristic, not an audited employee-count classification.
